g.text: 8 Place the two board adapters on the retained deck
Top view • board outlines dashed • filled circles are deck-to-adapter holes • open circles are PCB holes
FRONT / +X
LEFT / +Y
USB
Ethernet
P10 Pi 4B adapter
Deck rows 2 and 8, column 3 from each side.
Pi holes: 49 mm fore/aft × 58 mm across.
USB sockets face LEFT; USB-C faces FRONT.
P9 OpenCR adapter
Deck rows 10 and 20, column 4 from each side.
Board holes: 66 mm fore/aft × 96 mm across.
Micro-USB faces LEFT; 3-pin TTL bank faces FRONT.
Separate fixing points
4 × 12 mm columns beneath each adapter.
4 × 6 mm insulating spacers beneath each PCB.
Board screws pass through the adapter
and end in nuts below it.
Assemble off the chassis in this order
1. Fix the four 60 mm columns to the deck. 2. Fix the 12 mm columns under each empty adapter.
3. Fit each PCB with its 6 mm spacers and through-bolts. 4. Bolt both assemblies to the deck from below.
5. Set the completed deck onto the chassis and fit its four bottom screws. Keep all power disconnected.
The HAT, cooling, LiDAR plate and moving camera mount follow this bare-board stage.
P6 Upper deck: deck_p0.stl | P9 OpenCR adapter: opencr_adapter_s1.stl
P10 Pi 4B adapter: pi4_adapter_s1.stl
